facts.business: Park Medi World Ltd operates a network of 17 hospitals across North India (Delhi, Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand) providing multi-specialty healthcare services with a focus on accessible and affordable care.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Industry outlook indicates private hospitals to add 10,000 beds over this fiscal and next, with capex exceeding ₹30,000 crore to add 14,500 beds by FY 2026-27

key_risks: Geopolitical developments and energy market disruptions
High public debt and fiscal pressures
Trade tensions and supply chain disruptions
Concentration risk in North India market
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties entered into during FY 2025-26 were at arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business. No materially significant Related Party Transactions during the year. Form AOC-2 not applicable.
